intent.proves: Field display groups: unnamed-groups satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Needs authenticated full-payload and scope parity measurement; descriptor existence alone is insufficient.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(g.FieldDisplayGroupId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(g.FieldDisplayGroupSystemName, N'') FROM EcomFieldDisplayGroups g WHERE NOT (ISNULL(g.FieldDisplayGroupName, N'') <> N'' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomFieldDisplayGroupTranslation t WHERE (t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationGroupId = g.FieldDisplayGroupId OR t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationGroupSystemName = g.FieldDisplayGroupSystemName) AND t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(t.FieldDisplayGroupTranslationText, N'') <> N''))
